title: Prove O(n²) growth of rateb_app_route static $conflictRoots
instrumentation: temporary twin of rateb_app_route only; app.php restored after run

answer.estimated_complexity: O(N²) total: call k array_merge-copies ~45+8*(k-1) elements; Σ k = O(N²). Dominated by array_merge (416.0 ms / 423.4 ms = 98.3% of function wall), not explode (0.3 ms) or in_array (6.3 ms).

lookup_trend.note: Per-call wall stays ~0.35 ms after warmup (merge allocation floor); in_array avg rises ~24× early→late; cumulative cost is quadratic via repeated growing merges.
